title: Noun + preposition (reason for, cause of etc.)
subtitle: Какой предлог идёт после существительного: reason for, cause of

theory.text: Многие английские существительные «требуют» определённого предлога. Русский перевод часто подсказывает неверный вариант, поэтому такие сочетания лучше запоминать целиком: the reason for, a solution to, an increase in.

head: Предлог
Существительные
Пример
rows: a demand, a need, a reason
a photo, a picture, a map, a plan; a cause; an advantage/disadvantage
a map of Rome, the cause of the fire
an increase, a decrease, a rise, a fall
a relationship, a connection, contact (с кем-то)
a relationship, a connection, a difference (между двумя)
a solution, a key, an answer, a reply, a reaction, damage, an invitation, an attitude

theory.text: The advantage of + сущ./-ing: The advantage of a small car is… Но «есть преимущество в том, чтобы…» — there is an advantage in/to doing something.

items: damage to the car — повреждение машины (не damage of).
an invitation to a party — приглашение на вечеринку.

theory.text: Русское «причина чего-то», «решение проблемы», «ответ на вопрос» тянет к of или on. Правильно: the reason for, a solution to the problem, an answer to the question, a reply to my email.

items.ru: Сейчас большой спрос на электромобили.
en: There is a big demand for electric cars now.
Now there is a big demand for electric cars.

items.ru: Такси не нужно, я пойду пешком.
en: There's no need for a taxi, I'll walk.
There's no need for a taxi, I'm going to walk.
I don't need a taxi, I'll walk.

items.ru: Какая причина твоего решения?
en: What is the reason for your decision?

items.ru: Нам нужна карта Парижа.
en: We need a map of Paris.

items.ru: Анна показала мне фотографии своей собаки.
en: Anna showed me some photos of her dog.
Anna showed me photos of her dog.
Anna showed me some pictures of her dog.
Anna showed me pictures of her dog.

items.ru: В этом году был рост цен.
en: There was a rise in prices this year.
There has been a rise in prices this year.
There was an increase in prices this year.
There has been an increase in prices this year.

items.ru: Произошло падение количества туристов.
en: There was a fall in the number of tourists.
There has been a fall in the number of tourists.
There was a decrease in the number of tourists.

items.ru: У Тома хорошие отношения с начальником.
en: Tom has a good relationship with his boss.

items.ru: Ты поддерживаешь связь со своими школьными друзьями?
en: Do you have contact with your school friends?
Are you in contact with your school friends?

items.ru: Какая разница между этими двумя словами?
en: What's the difference between these two words?

items.ru: Между этими двумя событиями нет связи.
en: There's no connection between these two events.
There's no connection between the two events.

items.ru: Какое преимущество работы дома?
en: What is the advantage of working at home?
What is the advantage of working from home?

items.ru: Главный недостаток этой квартиры — шум.
en: The main disadvantage of this flat is the noise.
The main disadvantage of this apartment is the noise.

items.ru: В том, чтобы вставать рано, есть много преимуществ.
en: There are many advantages in getting up early.
There are many advantages to getting up early.
There are a lot of advantages in getting up early.
There are a lot of advantages to getting up early.

items.ru: Мы ещё не нашли решения этой проблемы.
en: We haven't found a solution to this problem yet.
We haven't found a solution to the problem yet.
We haven't yet found a solution to this problem.

items.ru: Где ключ от этой двери?
en: Where is the key to this door?

items.ru: Я не знаю ответа на твой вопрос.
en: I don't know the answer to your question.

items.ru: Она так и не получила ответа на своё письмо.
en: She never got a reply to her letter.
She never received a reply to her letter.
She didn't get a reply to her letter.

items.ru: Какой была его реакция на новость?
en: What was his reaction to the news?

items.ru: Причина пожара до сих пор неизвестна.
en: The cause of the fire is still unknown.
The cause of the fire is still not known.

items.ru: Буря нанесла серьёзный ущерб нашему дому.
en: The storm caused serious damage to our house.
The storm did serious damage to our house.

items.ru: Ты получил приглашение на вечеринку Кейт?
en: Did you get an invitation to Kate's party?
Have you got an invitation to Kate's party?
Did you receive an invitation to Kate's party?

items.ru: Мне не нравится его отношение к работе.
en: I don't like his attitude to work.
I don't like his attitude towards work.
I don't like his attitude to his work.
I don't like his attitude towards his work.

items.ru: Почему у тебя такое отношение к учителям?
en: Why do you have this attitude to teachers?
Why do you have this attitude towards teachers?
Why do you have such an attitude to teachers?
Why do you have such an attitude towards teachers?
